title: 第1032章 大战神兽天龟第1031章 肆虐修仙城市
slug: 聚宝仙锅第1038章天龟肆虐
content_zh:
李凡闯荡修仙界数十载，还是第一次遇到这种人间炼狱的情况。
整个天贵城毁于一旦，哪里还能看到一点当初修仙城市的影子。
残恒破瓦，火球燃烧，到处都是低级修士的尸体。
这还只是一只神兽天龟分身！
如果，是一只真正的神兽天龟，恐怕整个寒天大陆都可能被完全颠覆，在历史长河中，来一个瞬间消失。
说时迟那时快！
神兽天龟分身怎么可能被动挨打，直接亮出第一种真正的攻击模式。
无数火球，从其口中喷出。
注意，这可不是普通的火球术。
首先，在温度上，虽然有一定距离，李凡都能感觉到火球本身的那种恐怖的炙热感。
即使是金丹老祖的高级法术，都无法比拟。
其次，是在速度上，还是拿金丹老祖的高级火系法术来比较，这火球喷发的速度，简直不可思议，至少是金丹老祖火系法术的几十倍。
可以想象一下，金丹老祖的火系法术，已经可以说，是速度惊人。
那么，这神兽天龟分身喷出的火球速度，用任何言语来形容，都可以说是不准确。
城主小姑娘，反应最快，直接释放一个极品瞬移符咒。
只是，这一次，小姑娘也郁闷了！
砰！
小姑娘的身躯，竟然撞到一片无形的灵光组成的灵气墙上。
透明！
这个灵气墙，完全的透明，根本无法及时的发现。

即使拥有五次脱胎换骨后感官异常敏感的李凡，都无法准确的判断这灵气墙的位置。
李凡呢，只能是大概判断，应该原来天贵城城池的范围，都被灵气墙封锁了！
注意一点，这灵气墙可不是修士，包括筑基，甚至金丹老祖释放的那种最基本的法术。
这灵气墙的规模，还有厚度，防御力，都根本不是修士施展的法术，所能比拟的。
现在，有一个疑问，这灵气墙是本来就存在，还是神兽天龟分身释放的呢？
李凡觉得，后者的可能性更大一些。
果然是神兽天龟分身，其手段，根本不是一般修士能够想象的。
很明显，这神兽天龟分身是没打算放过一个人。
不止是原来城池位置的幸存者，还包括四十几位金丹老祖。
“防御！”
小姑娘到现在，还不忘履行一个城主的责任，对着所有修士大吼一声。
小姑娘也只能如此！
在体型完全是一座修仙城市大小的庞然大物面前，人类是显得如此的渺小。
content_en:
Li Fan has been wandering in the world of immortality for decades, and this is the first time he has encountered such a situation of purgatory on earth.
The entire Tiangui City was destroyed, and there is no trace of the original city that cultivated immortality.
The ruins were shattered, fireballs were burning, and the bodies of low-level monks were everywhere.
This is just a clone of the divine beast Sky Turtle!
If it were a real divine beast, the Sky Turtle, I am afraid that the entire Hantian Continent might be completely subverted and disappear in an instant in the long river of history.
It's too late, it's faster than that!
How could the clone of the divine beast Sky Turtle be passively beaten and directly show its first real attack mode?
Countless fireballs erupted from its mouth.
Note, this is no ordinary fireball.
First of all, in terms of temperature, Li Fan could feel the terrifying heat of the fireball itself even though there was a certain distance.
Even the advanced spells of the Jindan Patriarch are incomparable.
Secondly, in terms of speed, let's compare it with the advanced fire spells of the Jindan ancestor. The speed at which this fireball erupts is simply incredible, at least dozens of times that of the Jindan ancestor's fire spells.
It can be imagined that the fire spells of the Jindan Patriarch can already be said to be incredibly fast.
So, any words can be used to describe the speed of the fireball ejected by the clone of the divine beast Sky Turtle. It can be said that it is inaccurate.
The little city lord girl reacted the fastest and directly released a top-notch teleportation spell.
However, this time, the little girl was also depressed!
Bang!
The little girl's body actually hit an aura wall composed of invisible auras.
transparent!
This aura wall is completely transparent and cannot be discovered in time.
Even Li Fan, who had extremely sensitive senses after being reborn five times, could not accurately judge the location of the aura wall.
As for Li Fan, he could only make a rough judgment. It should be that the entire Tiangui City was blocked by the aura wall!
Please note that this aura wall is not the most basic spell released by monks, foundation builders, or even the ancestors of the Golden Pill.
The scale, thickness, and defensive power of this aura wall are simply not comparable to the spells cast by monks.
Now, I have a question, does this aura wall originally exist, or was it released by the clone of the divine beast Sky Turtle?
Li Fan feels that the latter is more likely.
Sure enough, it was a clone of the divine beast Sky Turtle, and its methods were beyond the imagination of ordinary monks.
It was obvious that this clone of the divine beast Sky Turtle had no intention of letting anyone go.
Not only the survivors from the original city location, but also more than forty Jindan ancestors.
"Defense!"
The little girl still hasn't forgotten to fulfill her responsibilities as a city lord and yelled at all the monks.
That’s all the little girl can do!
In front of a behemoth that is completely the size of an immortal city, human beings appear so small.
